messages:
sam_support: P1 escalation: Rivermark trial onboarding failing intermittently — embed provisioning returning 403 on token validation. Customer usage spiking, renewal in ~5w. Ticket #SUP-123456. Looping @zoe_cs_lead and @marta_customer_success for CS handoff & comms plan. Details below.

oncall-bot: Alert: 5 failed provisioning attempts for tenant rivermark-prod in last 24h. Avg latency normal. https://redwood.inc/alerts/ABCD1234

marta_customer_success: Got it, thx. I'll own comms. Can we get a short RCA from eng/support and a list of impacted endpoints + last successful deploy time? Need to prepare a customer-facing note.

sam_support: Quick logs pasted here for context:
```json
{
  "tenant": "rivermark-prod",
  "error": "403",
  "msg": "token expired",
  "ts": "2026-03-20T02:14:31Z"
}
```
We also saw their key rotation automation fail. Support asked them to rotate keys manually but they reported automation retries still hit 403.

liam_engineering: We shipped a patch to the token refresh path yesterday for a corner case — rolling back to confirm. I can run a targeted repro with a sample token if we get it. @kyle_se can you coordinate secure transfer of a short-lived token?

kyle_se: I can take the secure upload. Marta — can you ask Rivermark to upload a short-lived token via our secure form (presigned S3) and confirm a 30-min window for troubleshooting tomorrow 10:00am PST?

zoe_cs_lead: Plan proposal:
1) Immediate: set expectations with customer + provide a temporary workaround (manual key rotate + retry guidance)
2) 10:00am PST debugging session with eng + SE + customer
3) Post-mortem + comms template + renewal-risk note to AE/AM
Marta pls draft customer message by EOD; I'll join the call.

marta_customer_success: Drafting now. Suggested short note:
"Hi Rivermark — we\'re seeing intermittent provisioning failures tied to token refresh. We\'re scheduling a 10:00am PST troubleshooting call and recommending a one-time manual key rotate as a temporary workaround. We\'re prioritizing this and will follow up with a root cause and mitigation plan within 24 hours. For urgent issues contact ops@redwood.com or the 24/7 support line."
Thoughts?

sam_support: :thumbsup: Looks good. Add the ticket link and the list of impacted endpoints in the note. I\'ll add an internal note and mark SUP-123456 as P1.

zoe_cs_lead: Assigning owners: @marta_customer_success (customer comms & AE handoff), @liam_engineering (eng owner), @kyle_se (SE troubleshooting). Marta, please update the ticket with the comms draft, invite AE/AM, and confirm calendar invite. I\'ll prepare a renewal-risk flag for sales to monitor and a short-runbook for the call.

marta_customer_success: Done — ticket SUP-123456 updated, calendar invites sent for 10:00am PST, AE/AM included. Will post final customer note once Zoe gives the OK. Thanks everyone. :pray:

oncall-bot: Incident workflow created: INCIDENT-20260320-09. Runbook: onboarding-provisioning. Escalation level: CS-P1.
